summary.text: Jennifer Bacon, a Democrat, has represented District 7 in the Colorado House of Representatives since January 2021; she previously served on the Denver Public Schools Board of Education (District 4) from 2017 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, she advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.

Bacon was born in Miami, Florida, and earned a bachelor's degree from Tulane University (2004), a graduate degree from Florida International University (2006), and a J.D. from the College of William & Mary's Marshall-Wythe School of Law (2009).
Her career experience includes working as an educator.
